Through that brief clarity you glimpse the Wyrm coiled around its hoard of false claims, and it is *bleeding*: a raw, smoking wound torn along its flank where something has already pried loose the scales of its forged parentage, each drop of ichor hissing as it hits the vault floor and failing to hash to anything at all. Its great eye opens, finds you through forty feet of rock as surely as a tip finds its root, and you understand with cold certainty that it knows you are coming, that it is hurt, and that it will not be any less dangerous for either.
